label: Numerals (Ordinal & Collective)
description: A 20-question check on the ordinal and collective numeral lessons.

questions.prompt: In «Это мой первый рабочий день.», what does «первый» mean?
questions.explain: «Первый» is the ordinal 'first', here agreeing with masculine 'день' in the nominative singular.

questions.prompt: Why is the ordinal «втором» used in «Она живёт на втором этаже.»?
options: It is plural to match many floors
It agrees with masculine 'этаже' in the prepositional case after 'на'
It is in the genitive because of a date
questions.explain: Floors use 'на' plus the prepositional case, so 'втором' agrees with masculine 'этаже' there.

questions.prompt: The ordinal «третий» is special because it has which kind of endings?
questions.explain: Among the ordinals 'третий' is unique with soft endings, e.g. «третьем», «третья», «третье».

questions.prompt: In «Третья дверь была закрыта.», which form does the soft ordinal take to agree with feminine «дверь»?
questions.explain: Soft-stem 'третий' takes the feminine ending -ья, giving «третья» to agree with feminine 'дверь'.

questions.prompt: In «Третье окно выходит во двор.», «третье» is in this form because «окно» is which gender?
questions.explain: 'Третий' takes the neuter soft ending -ье to form «третье», agreeing with neuter 'окно'.

questions.prompt: Like what part of speech do ordinal numerals such as «первый» and «пятый» decline?
questions.explain: Ordinals decline like adjectives, agreeing with their noun in gender, number and case.

questions.prompt: In «Я прочитал вторую главу книги.», why is «вторую» used?
options: It agrees with feminine 'главу' in the accusative as a direct object
It is a date in the genitive
It marks a floor in the prepositional
questions.explain: 'Вторую' takes the feminine accusative ending -ую to agree with the direct object 'главу'.

questions.prompt: In «Дети сидят за первым столом.», the form «первым» is in which case after «за»?
questions.explain: 'Первым' agrees with masculine 'столом' in the instrumental after 'за', using the ending -ым.

questions.prompt: What does «Седьмой» mean in «Седьмой день недели - воскресенье.»?
questions.explain: «Седьмой» is the ordinal 'seventh', agreeing with masculine 'день' in the nominative.

questions.prompt: In «Я взял книгу с девятой полки.», «девятой» is in the genitive after «с» and agrees with which word?
questions.explain: 'Девятой' agrees with feminine 'полки' in the genitive after 'с'.

questions.prompt: What does «Десятый» mean in «Десятый этаж самый высокий.»?
questions.explain: «Десятый» is the ordinal 'tenth', agreeing with masculine 'этаж' in the nominative.

questions.prompt: When naming today's date, as in «Сегодня первое мая.», the ordinal is in which form?
questions.explain: A bare date naming the day uses the neuter nominative ordinal «первое» for the implied 'число'; the month stays genitive.

questions.prompt: In «Концерт был третьего марта.», to say WHEN something happened the ordinal goes into which case?
questions.explain: To say when something happened, the ordinal takes the genitive: «третьего», with the month «марта» also genitive.

questions.prompt: In «Экзамен будет двадцать второго июня.», which word of the compound ordinal declines?
questions.explain: Only the last word of a compound ordinal declines: «второго» takes the genitive while «двадцать» stays fixed.

questions.prompt: Floors use «на» plus which case, as in «Мы живём на пятом этаже.»?
questions.explain: Floors use 'на' plus the prepositional case; «пятом» agrees with masculine 'этаже' in the prepositional.

questions.prompt: Collective numerals like «двое», «трое», «четверо» govern which case of the following noun?
questions.explain: Collective numerals govern the genitive plural, e.g. «двое детей», «трое друзей», «четверо студентов».

questions.prompt: In «У них двое детей.», the form «детей» is in which case?
questions.explain: The collective «двое» governs the genitive plural, so 'дети' appears as genitive plural «детей».

questions.prompt: With plural-only nouns like «сутки» or «ножницы», as in «Мы ехали четверо суток.», collective numerals are:
questions.explain: With pluralia tantum nouns like 'сутки' a collective is obligatory; «четверо» governs the genitive plural «суток».

questions.prompt: In the predicative «Нас было трое.», what form does the past link verb take?
questions.explain: Used standalone, «трое» counts the genitive 'нас' and the past link verb stays neuter singular «было».

questions.prompt: What does «Нас здесь только двое.» mean?
options: There are only two of us here
We live on the second floor
questions.explain: Standalone «двое» with genitive 'нас' states the group size: 'there are only two of us here'.
